name: Jeffery Asare
subject: Print inquiry
message: Hi Jeffery, I came across your work and I’m interested in purchasing a print. Could you tell me more about the available sizes, paper options, and pricing?
replyText: My work is available in limited edition archival prints, signed and numbered, shipped worldwide from Accra. Sizes range from A3 to A2, and papers are cotton rag or Baryta, depending on the piece. Prices vary, but expect around GHS 1,500 - 5,000 or USD 250 - 800 for a single print.

subject: Print inquiry
message: How do I make payment and how long does it take to get to me?
replyText: To make a purchase, just go to my website and select the print you want, then follow the Paystack link to complete the transaction. Payment typically takes 24-48 hours to process, and then I ship the print from Accra.
